status: Provisional simulation mass, inertia and propulsion parameters.
caveats: Total mass includes reused Avia 0.498 kg, eight 0.35 kg equivalent VMG rotor links and four explicit provisional payload masses.
Base budget includes batteries and airframe; equivalent-box inertia is synthetic. Payload centres/inertias use bounding-box approximations.
Spin assignment is a conventional balanced X8 choice, not inferred from CAD prop handedness.
Motor housings are fixed to base_link; propeller meshes rotate on the thrust-producing rotor joints. The visual slowdown factor does not change the configured thrust law.
Rotor thrust is applied at measured motor origins. Separate prop hub axial offset is unmeasured.
No coaxial interference, blade flapping, calibrated airframe drag or real P60 power/ESC response.
Flight IMU is at the body datum with body FLU axes; CAD Pixhawk origin is not a measured internal IMU centre.
Controller defaults require flight tuning on the real airframe.
